scope: 17 current runtime W and SE, 16 frames each
method: Viewed all 32 whole-frame poses and fixed-position enlarged leg contact sheets; checked knee, ankle and heel-to-toe orientation against adjacent frames.

W.01-02: Rear recovery boot pitches with the folded lower leg; forward boot remains leftward along the side-view motion plane.
W.03-06: Knee-lift and toe-down positions keep the heel attached to the same lower-leg axis; no isolated sideways yaw identified.
W.07-08: Forward extension pitches the toe up toward landing. Visible sole edge is pitch, not a foot rotated away from the direction.
W.09-10: Opposite recovery boot keeps its sagittal heel-up relation; foreground support boot remains leftward.
W.11-16: Forward swing retains a leftward long axis through the successive knee/ankle poses. No frame-specific outward-twist defect identified.

SE.01-02 and 09-10: Landing boot toe remains lower-right along the diagonal direction; rear recovery leg stays folded.
SE.03-06 and 11-14: Under-body support and knee recovery use front/three-quarter foreshortening consistently; ankle is not detached or abruptly rolled outward.
SE.07-08 and 15-16: Forward boot pitches upward, exposing some sole; its heel-to-toe axis continues lower-right with the lower leg rather than turning into a lateral kick.

limitation: Visual judgment, not measured 3D joint angles. User screenshot is another character and is not evidence that these 32 poses require edits.
